parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=8, MATRIX_LR=0.05, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 (val_bpb 0.9884). Capacity and warmup are working, and lowering LR from 0.05 to 0.04 might provide even more stability for this deeper architecture. Next, I will test MATRIX_LR=0.04 to see if slower, more stable convergence yields better results.
parsed.description: Lowering the learning rate from 0.05 to 0.04 to investigate if more stable, fine-grained optimization further improves convergence for the DEPTH=8 model.
